{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Step 1: Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = data[data['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}")

# Step 2: Clean revenue — remove commas and convert to float
# Check for any non-numeric revenue values
print("\nRevenue values (first 10):")
print(completed_orders['revenue'].head(10))

# Replace commas and convert to float
completed_orders['revenue_clean'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Step 3: Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = completed_orders['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_count}")

# Remove QA orders
cleaned_orders = completed_orders[~qa_mask]

# Step 4: Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = cleaned_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue:.2f}")

# Output final value
mean_revenue"}
